items.title: CapCut templates, cut properly
items.text: A CapCut template link now gives one short clip per slot, cut in the middle of the template's transitions, with its blurs, flashes and fades as ClipCut transitions. Right-click a slot and choose Replace clip to put yours in.

items.title: The sound library
items.text: Audio › ClipCut sounds: free sound effects and music in categories, each with who made it. New sounds show up without updating the app.

items.title: Watermark templates
items.text: Text › Watermarks: eight animated name and handle styles to sign your videos with.

items.title: 16 new effects and transitions
items.text: Zoom Pulse, Mirror, Kaleidoscope, Strobe, Cinema Bars, Wave Warp, Duotone and Light Sweep; Shake Cut, Ink Spread, Pixel Dissolve, Flash Zoom, Squeeze, Roll Up, Diamond Wipe and Split Open.

items.title: 6 new text animations
items.text: Stomp, Tilt, Shake, Elastic, Unfold and Whip.

items.title: Snow
items.text: Settings › Appearance › Snow: snow falling over the window, with any look.

items.title: ClipCut watermark
items.text: Exported videos carry a small ClipCut logo in the top-right corner.
